name: Nondescript Letter
summary: Calvin Montague sends a Nondescript Letter east from Deathknell to Innkeeper Renee in Brill. He gives it to newly awakened Forsaken as an excuse to leave the valley and reach the Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: A Courier's Errand
sections.body: Calvin Montague asks newly arisen Forsaken near Deathknell to carry an unmarked envelope east to Brill. He claims he is tired from fighting zombies and spiders, and says the letter is for an innkeeper named Renee. His promise of rich compensation sounds hollow, and the errand takes travelers out of the valley toward the Gallows' End Tavern.

sections.title: Suspicious Correspondence
sections.body: Innkeeper Renee first pretends the letter brings sweet news from her saintly mother in Deathknell. When she sees the courier is not fooled, her cheerful manner gives way to irritation. She snatches the letter, refuses to say who sent it or what it contains, and orders the bearer away unless they mean to pay for a room.

faq.answer: The Nondescript Letter is a plain, unmarked envelope Calvin Montague gives newly awakened Forsaken in Deathknell to carry to Innkeeper Renee in Brill.

faq.q: Who sends the letter, and who receives it?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague gives the letter to couriers in Deathknell. It is addressed to Innkeeper Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill.

faq.q: What does the letter actually say?
faq.answer: The letter's contents are never revealed. When you ask, Innkeeper Renee drops her cheerful act and angrily says its origins and contents are none of your business.

faq.q: Why does Calvin Montague want it delivered?
faq.answer: Calvin claims he is too busy fighting local zombies and spiders to carry the letter himself. The delivery sends travelers out of Deathknell and introduces them to Brill's inns and resting places.

angles.text: As a rogue, Calvin Montague's shifty manner and Renee's abrupt change of mood suggest intrigue and coded underworld messages.
As a newly risen Forsaken, carrying this letter gives you an early reason to leave Deathknell and explore the settlements of Tirisfal Glades.
